title: Fools Will Resign!

So, if you are a follower of the channel, you should know that fools will resign. It's the opening. I would honestly play on even if I'm playing one of my games, because there is a lot to learn from playing a lost position. Even if, of course, nine times out of 10, you're just going to lose.
